proposed_contract.handler_policy: No new device handler is added. The product owns only VIC raster. All other software-maskable internal sources are disabled before CLI; the existing source-less episode guard stays byte-for-byte in force.
proposed_contract.supported_hardware_profile: No interrupt-generating expansion cartridge may be active while the C2-lite product owns the vectors. Passive cartridges remain outside this interrupt policy. One foreign/source-less IRQ per raster-delimited episode is tolerated for a legitimate Freezer return; a held or repeating cartridge interrupt storm is unsupported and deliberately fail-closed.
proposed_contract.diagnostic_boundary: Under the supported profile and the reachable-BRK gate, a source-less IRQ after the new masks is the already-contracted Freezer/hypervisor return class; two consecutive entries without raster progress still fail closed.

required_gates_before_link: Core-graph inventory equality: every leaf in the tested-core IRQ/NMI cone is classified exactly once.
Ownership-source gate: the three new writes occur after I/O personality selection, under SEI, and before CLI.
Readback gate: the three enable masks are checked before raster enable.
Negative mutation per family: omit or alter the Ethernet, Auto-IEC or Audio-DMA mask and the gate is red.
Audio-DMA-as-impossible and F011-as-IRQ-source mutations are red against the exact RTL.
Decoded reachable BRK mutation is red.
The existing raster-only, Freezer-episode, Z-boundary, owned-window and KERNAL-freedom gates replay unchanged.
